about.text: Kalmyk milk tea is brick tea boiled for five to six minutes with cow, sheep or camel milk and salt, then strained through a horsehair sieve; butter, bay leaf, nutmeg or clove are sometimes added. The Kalmyks brought it from Dzungaria in the 17th century, and it spread to North Caucasian and Volga peoples.
